title: FAQ banner block missing entirely on /faqs/limited-by-guarantee/ and /faqs/limited-by-shares/
body: **Surfaced by T9 (CORE-7013) verification, 2026-08-24 — a DIFFERENT defect from that ticket.** CORE-7013 is about banner *resolution*. While sweeping all 23 FAQ topic pages to verify it, two pages turned out to have **no banner at all** on the clone, while live renders one. | Page | Live | Clone | |---|---|---| | `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/` | banner, 800px master shown at 1170×252 | **no banner element** | | `/faqs/limited-by-shares/` | banner, 800px master shown at 1170×252 | **no banner element** | Measured at viewport 1800 on both sites: on the clone neither page has any `` wider than 400px above y=700 (16 images present, widest is a 275×28 logo at y=1093). The other 21 FAQ topic pages all render the banner correctly. Most likely the banner block was never added to these two pages in the CMS (a seeding gap), rather than a code defect — the shared template works on the other 21. Confirm in Payload before treating it as code. **Not fixed under T9**: T9 is scoped to resolution, its own acceptance criteria say the crop and block must otherwise stay as-is, and a missing block is a separate class of defect.
acceptanceCriteria: `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/` and `/faqs/limited-by-shares/` render the FAQ banner, matching live in position, crop and size (1170×250 at desktop).
The banner image is served at ≥ its displayed size, consistent with the other 21 FAQ topic pages (1170×250 master).
No change to the other 21 FAQ topic pages, which already render correctly.
